title: 第七章 青龙泣血武圣浴血抗千杀第八章 方天喋血疯魔吕布战尽孤勇
lines: 断龙原左翼战场，烽火燎原，焦土漫天，刺骨杀机弥漫每一寸空域。
关羽巍然立於阵前，赤面长髯迎风猎猎，青绿战甲覆满烟尘，一身浩然正气冲霄贯日。
胯下赤兔神驹四蹄踏立冻土，纵使深陷四面绝境，依旧威仪凛然、风骨铮铮，无半分怯馁。
身为龙国武道忠义之魂，他一生征战光明磊落、正大光明，素来鄙夷暗处诡诈阴私，擅长正面稳战、守阵定心，天生克制正面强攻之敌，却唯独无解幻境、潜行、毒术、远程消耗类诡诈战法。
而围杀他的三大星曜，能力招式恰好完美克制其武道短板，搭配后方法系星曜全域压制，形成无解连环死局。
白羊?阿顶，星火焚阵、正面强攻，擅长燎原火攻与近身破防，战意狂暴、攻势连绵，专破正面守势，克制关羽稳扎稳打的阵地战法。
天蝎?阿刺，潜行匿影、淬毒封脉，掌蕴星毒、针藏寂灭，擅长暗处偷袭、专攻经脉丹田，瓦解武者本源根基，专克光明正大、不设防暗袭的正统武道。
射手?阿矢，高空狙杀、破甲裂罡，星弓星箭无虚发，擅长远程消耗、封死走位，以距离优势拉扯战局，不断耗损战甲气血。
不止正面三神压制，中路与阵后星曜同步开启全域debuff，层层枷锁、永续无解。
双子?樱木幻影催动无尽全域幻境，千重真假镜像滋生蔓延，漫山遍野皆是虚妄惨状，死死撕扯关羽心神道心、磨灭战斗意志。
水瓶?樱木辰光引动极寒星力，冻土封川、寒冰锁足，禁锢关羽身法走位，彻底剥夺其机动冲锋、迂回突围的能力。
处女?樱木灵丹释放净化星光，丝丝缕缕剥离关羽千年凝练的浩然战气，持续消解武道本源、透支根基。
天秤?樱木玄衡执掌法则判罚，精准制衡战力，关羽刀势越猛、力道越强，法则反噬便越重，越战越疲、越打越伤。
同时上千星曜死士结成小型联动星阵，层层叠叠合围堵截，以人海疲敌、以阵法耗敌，妄图硬生生拖垮一代武圣。
“萤火星火诡术，也敢污我武道清白！”
关羽怒喝震谷，声浪吹散周遭细碎星雾，青龙偃月刀顺势横空斩落，万丈纯粹金色刀气撕裂漫天燎原烈焰。
白羊?阿顶催动的滔天火海声势骇人，却在浩然正道刀势面前瞬间二分、溃散无形。
磅礴刀气裹挟正道威压碾压而下，狠狠轰击在白羊?阿顶星铠之上。
哐当！
金铁轰鸣震彻四野，刺耳嗡鸣不绝于耳。
白羊?阿顶贴身星铠寸寸龟裂，身躯遭万斤巨力轰然撞击，倒飞数十丈，口中狂喷滚烫星血，重重砸落地面，身躯剧烈震颤，已然身受重创。
一刀重创一尊星曜主力，武圣威势骇人，震慑全场。
未等白羊?阿顶起身反扑，关羽刀势轮转不息、杀伐不止，浩然刀气横扫方圆百丈。
周遭蜂拥扑来的数十名星曜死士连惨叫都来不及发出，身躯尽数被凌厉刀气撕裂，星甲破碎、星血纷飞，一地残尸碎骨铺满焦土。
左翼固若金汤的星阵合围，顷刻被他一人劈开血色缺口，无人可挡其锋。
可未等关羽乘胜突围，暗处致命杀机已然悄然而至。
天蝎?阿刺敛尽周身气息，隐入星雾阴影，身法诡谲无声，借火海消散的烟尘完美掩护。
数枚淬满封灵剧毒的星针破空疾射，轨迹刁钻隐秘，精准锁定关羽后心丹田、经脉、后腰三大致命要害。
星针纤细无形、速逾闪电，专破武道护体罡气，一旦入体，即刻封脉禁灵、禁锢修为。
关羽千年战感敏锐至极，心神骤紧，仓促侧身极速闪避。
嗤！
一枚星针擦过肩甲，刺破皮肉，刺骨的封灵剧毒顺着经脉飞速蔓延全身，半边身躯瞬间麻木僵硬，气血流转滞涩不堪，一身巅峰战力骤然折损三成。
高地之上，射手?阿矢早已蓄势待发，星纹长弓拉满如月，弓弦震颤间，三枚破甲星箭接连破空。
快如流星、分工明确，一箭破护体罡气，一箭锁足封步，一箭直取咽喉，封死所有闪避空间。
关羽强忍半边身躯的麻痹剧痛，偃月刀极速轮转，刀光翻飞织成密不透风的防御壁垒。
密集金铁交鸣炸响不绝，火星四溅，三枚星箭尽数被格挡震碎。
可箭势裹挟的磅礴力道层层叠加，震得他气血翻涌、心口闷痛，脚步不由自主连连后撤数步。
content_en:
The left battlefield of Duanlongyuan was ablaze with flames, the sky was filled with scorched earth, and every inch of the airspace was filled with bone-chilling murderous intent.
Guan Yu stood majestically in front of the formation, his red face and long beard hunting in the wind, his green armor covered with smoke and dust, and his awe-inspiring righteousness soaring into the sky.
The red rabbit divine horse under its crotch has four hooves standing on the frozen soil. Even though it is trapped in desperate situations on all sides, it is still majestic and strong-willed, without any hint of timidity.
As the loyal soul of the martial arts of the Dragon Kingdom, he has fought openly and honestly throughout his life. He has always despised the deceitful and cunning tactics in the dark. He is good at frontal stable battles, holding formations and staying focused, and is naturally capable of restraining enemies who attack from the front. However, he is only incapable of deceitful tactics such as illusions, stealth, poison techniques, and long-range consumption.
The abilities and moves of the three major stars that surrounded him perfectly overcame his martial arts shortcomings, and combined with the full-area suppression of the star stars in the system, they formed an inextricable chain of deadlocks.
Aries? A Ding, a star-burning formation, strong frontal attack, good at starting a prairie fire attack and breaking the defense at close range, with violent fighting spirit and continuous offensive, specializing in breaking the frontal defense, and restraining Guan Yu's steady and steady positional tactics.
Scorpio? A thorn, sneaking into shadow, quenching poison and sealing veins, containing star poison in the palm, hiding silence in the needle, good at sneak attacks in the dark, specializing in the meridians and Dantian, disintegrating the original foundation of the martial artist, specializing in the orthodox martial arts that is open and honest, and unprepared for secret attacks.
Archer? Aya, a high-altitude sniper, armor sundering, and star bow and arrows that are always in vain. He is good at long-range consumption and blocking movement. He uses his distance advantage to draw up the battle and constantly drain the armor's energy and blood.
Not only are the three gods suppressing the front, but the middle lane and Xing Yao behind the formation simultaneously activate global debuffs, layer upon layer of shackles, and there is no way to solve them.
The Twin Sakura phantoms stimulated endless global illusions. Thousands of true and false mirror images grew and spread, and the mountains and plains were filled with false and tragic scenes. They tore at Guan Yu's heart and mind and destroyed his will to fight.
Aquarius? Sakuragi Chenguang activated the extremely cold star power, the frozen soil sealed the river, and the ice locked the feet, imprisoning Guan Yu's movement, completely depriving him of the ability to maneuver and break through.
The virgin cherry tree elixir releases the purifying starlight, peeling off Guan Yu's thousands of years of condensed fighting spirit, and continues to dissolve the origin and overdraft foundation of martial arts.
Libra? Sakuragi Genheng is in charge of the law and punishment, accurately checking and balancing combat power. The fiercer and stronger Guan Yu's sword is, the more severe the backlash of the law will be. The more he fights, the more tired he becomes, and the more he fights, the more injured he becomes.
At the same time, thousands of Xingyao dead soldiers formed a small interlocking star formation, stacked up to encircle and intercept them, using the sea of ​​people to exhaust the enemy and the enemy formations, in an attempt to forcefully bring down a generation of martial saints.
"You dare to smear my martial arts innocence with the firefly tricks!"
Guan Yu shouted angrily at Zhengu, and the sound wave blew away the fine star mist around him. The Qinglong Yanyue Sword slashed down across the sky, and the pure golden sword energy tore through the prairie fire all over the sky.
The monstrous sea of ​​​​fire activated by Aries Ading was frightening, but it instantly split into two pieces and disintegrated invisible in front of Haoran's righteous sword.
The majestic sword energy rolled down with the pressure of the righteous way, and struck hard on the Aries Ading Star Armor.
Bang!
The roar of gold and iron shook the surrounding areas, and the ear-piercing buzzing was endless.
Aries? Ading's personal star armor was cracked, and his body was hit by a huge force of ten thousand kilograms, flying dozens of feet upside down. Hot star blood was sprayed from his mouth, and he hit the ground hard. His body was shaking violently, and he was already seriously injured.
A sword severely damaged a Xing Yao's main force, and the Martial Saint's power was frightening, shocking the entire audience.
Before Aries could wait, A Ding stood up and counterattacked. Guan Yu's sword kept turning and killing, and its awe-inspiring sword energy swept across a hundred feet in radius.
Dozens of Xingyao dead soldiers swarmed around them and didn't even have time to scream. Their bodies were all torn apart by the sharp sword energy. Their star armor was broken, star blood flew, and the ground was covered with corpses and broken bones.
The impregnable star array on the left wing was surrounded, and he opened a bloody gap in an instant, and no one could stop it.
But before Guan Yu could take advantage of the victory to break through, a deadly murderous intention had quietly arrived in the dark.
Scorpio Aqi gathered all his aura and disappeared into the shadow of the star mist. His movements were strange and silent, and he was perfectly covered by the smoke and dust dissipated by the sea of ​​fire.
Several star needles filled with the poisonous sealing spirit shot through the air with a cunning and secret trajectory, accurately targeting the three fatal points of Guan Yu's heart, dantian, meridians, and lower back.
The star needle is slender, invisible, and faster than lightning. It is specially designed to break through the martial arts' body-protecting aura. Once it enters the body, it immediately seals the veins, confines the spirit, and imprisons the cultivation level.
Guan Yu had a keen sense of battle for thousands of years, and his mind suddenly tightened, and he hurriedly turned sideways to dodge at high speed.
laugh!
A star needle grazed the shoulder armor and pierced the flesh. The biting spirit-sealing poison spread rapidly throughout the body along the meridians. Half of the body was instantly numb and stiff, the blood flow was stagnant, and 30% of the peak combat power was suddenly lost.
On the high ground, the archer Aya was already ready to go. His star-patterned long bow was drawn as full as the moon. As the bowstring trembled, three armor-piercing star arrows shot through the air one after another.
As fast as a shooting star, with a clear division of labor, one arrow breaks the body's protective aura, one arrow locks the feet and seals the steps, and one arrow goes straight to the throat, sealing off all dodge space.
Guan Yu endured the paralysis and severe pain in half of his body, and the Yanyue Sword rotated at extremely fast speeds. The sword light flew and weaved into an airtight defensive barrier.
The dense clash of gold and iron exploded continuously, sparks flew everywhere, and all three star arrows were blocked and shattered.
But the majestic force of the arrow was superimposed layer by layer, causing his blood to surge and his heart to feel tight and painful, and he couldn't help but take several steps back.
title_en: Chapter 7: The Green Dragon weeps blood and the Martial Saint bathes in blood and resists thousands of kills. Chapter 8: Fang Tian bleeds and the mad demon Lu Bu fights with all his courage.
